title: Tôi có thể nhận được một báo cáo bằng văn bản không?
englishTitle: Can I get a written report?
pronunciation: Toi co the nhan duoc mot bao cao bang van ban khong
summary: For asking airport staff for a written report, claim note, or incident record.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: The document matters later. Keep the baggage tag, form, receipt, or counter screen visible.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Ask for the report before leaving the counter. A claim number, printed note, or photo can save a second trip.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Tôi có thể asks can I; nhận được means get; báo cáo bằng văn bản means written report.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good for lost luggage, damaged bags, canceled pickups, insurance claims, or anything staff say must be documented.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Check that the report has a date, counter name, and reference number before you leave.
